newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Koramic sees eastern Europe growth.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Koramic sees eastern Europe growth.

text.p: Belgian building materials group Koramic Building Products NV said on Thursday it saw strong growth potential in eastern Europe.
"We have invested a lot in eastern Europe. In five to 10 years' time this should give an enormous potential," said Koramic chief executive officer Christian Dumolin.
Dumolin hoped eastern Europe would account for 10 to 15 percent of turnover in 10 years, from six percent at the moment.
He said the Asian market was important for the company's development and was confident about smooth growth on that continent.
Dumolin said business was stable in Belgium and the Netherlands and that France had a high growth potential.
But Germany and Austria were disappointing. "We will have two years of turbulent times in these markets," he said.
Koramic, formerly known as Terca Brick Industries NV, linked up with Austria's Wienerberger earlier this year.
